name: MiniMax Code
description: Runs MiniMax's open-source coding agent in the terminal for developers, with an interactive TUI, headless mcode exec with JSON output for CI, and an ACP server for editors.

skills.name: Headless Exec
skills.description: Runs a single task with mcode exec for shell scripts, CI and evaluations, with JSON output and stable exit codes.

skills.name: ACP Server
skills.description: Runs MiniMax Code as an Agent Client Protocol server over stdio for editors and agent hosts.

skills.name: Plan Mode
skills.description: Drafts a reviewable plan before making changes on large or uncertain tasks.

skills.name: Skills and MCP
skills.description: Loads configured skills, MCP servers and plugins into the agent.

skills.name: Session Recovery
skills.description: Continues the latest session or reopens a specific one by ID.
